name: Francisco Assis - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its yearly position on human rights and democracy in the world. It is not a law. It asks the EU to keep human rights at the centre of its foreign policy, to protect activists and journalists, to defend international courts, and to keep a dedicated budget for human rights and for women's rights. It also calls for sanctions against those who abuse rights, and for action on violence against women and on new technologies used to spy on people.

- The EU is asked to keep a separate human rights budget and add sanctions on abusers.
- It affects activists, journalists, women and minorities outside the EU.
- Next: the EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
